headline:
Check The Heat
Before You Need It
titan_line: Echo, the NFPA counted 37,365 home heating fires a year from 2020 to 2024. Space heaters and heating stoves caused 30% of those fires — and 73% of the deaths.
rows: Chimneys and heating systems get inspected and cleaned each year before the season — a licensed contractor's job
Anything that burns stays three feet clear of a heater — the spacing a fire department repeats every winter
A furnace that sat unused all summer is worth a look from a licensed HVAC contractor before the first cold night
echo_line: Thirty percent of the fires. Seventy-three percent of the deaths. That gap stays with me.
source: NFPA · Home Heating Fires, 2020–2024 annual averages · retrieved September 24, 2026
disclaimer: National figures, not local ones. General safety information only — not an inspection, and not advice about any particular home, appliance or heating system.
